title: Exernite's Discs
description: Ever wanted to craft music discs? Now you can!
body:
Exernite's Discs is a mod that adds 3 new items to your game!

New Items:
- Disc Crafter
- Disc Generator
- Droopy Likes Your Face (Music Disc)

Credit to [SunshineAudios](https://linktr.ee/sunshineaudios?utm_source=linktree_admin_share) for making the Disc Generator Art!
